ask.text: Your S1 take passes on the pair (right shoe, right hand). One note: from about 1.3 to 2.6 s the shoe tips onto its outer side and back (no flip). I'd use the clean insole-up parts. 5 more kits below, 12 credits each (60 total). Send each clip back as it's done.

sections.note: One shot at a time: open it, save its images, copy its prompt, make it in Flow (Gemini Omni Flash, 9:16, 4 s), download at 1080, send it back.

items.what: POV walk on the bricks, both shoes point away
items.prompt: Recreate image 1 exactly as the first frame: keep its place, light, framing, her skin, outfit and anklets exactly. Image 2 is the real woven side tab: a small black tab with white VANS letters. Image 3 is the real heel label: a small white OFF THE WALL skateboard label with black print. Image 4 is the product sheet: keep this exact shoe shape, size, checkerboard and colours, no added marks, no ® or ™, no extra text. Every mark on the shoe matches its image letter for letter and colour for colour and stays on the shoe the whole clip; only the black squares carry sequins. Motion: she walks forward at a relaxed pace, four real steps, the camera moves forward with her so the bricks clearly travel down and out of the bottom of the frame (no walking in place); both shoes point away from the camera toward the top of the frame the whole time, the same direction; no hand appears at any time. Camera: handheld phone, steady. Vertical 9:16 phone footage, bright neutral overcast daylight, realistic skin, at most two shoes in frame. No sparkle effects, no music, no voice, no captions, no on-screen text.
